intro.fr: Inazuma Eleven a un randomizer partagé par la communauté Victory Road.
intro.en: Inazuma Eleven has a randomizer shared by the Victory Road community.

text.fr: LEVEL-5 sort Inazuma Eleven sur Nintendo DS en 2008.
text.en: LEVEL-5 releases Inazuma Eleven on Nintendo DS in 2008.

text.fr: L'Ultimate Randomizer, qui couvre les trois premiers Inazuma Eleven sur DS, est distribué sur Mega ; l'assistance et les futures versions passent par le serveur Discord de Victory Road.
text.en: The Ultimate Randomizer, which covers the first three Inazuma Eleven games on DS, is distributed on Mega; support and future versions go through the Victory Road Discord server.
